visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with an extreme close-up of a signature dish, Meizi Chicken, presented in a blue and white patterned ceramic bowl on a light-grained wooden table. The fried chicken pieces are heavily glazed in a dark, glossy plum sauce, interspersed with several whole, dark brown wrinkled plums and sprinkled with white sesame seeds. (2) A medium shot follows as a person's hands place a black portable gas stove on the wooden table, while a stainless steel pot of soup is already steaming. Around it are plates of fried rice and vegetables, suggesting a full dining experience in a bright indoor setting. (3) The scene shifts to a slightly blurred wide shot of a bustling restaurant interior where several customers are seated at wooden tables under bright white ceiling lights. The environment is casual and crowded, with people dressed in everyday attire such as t-shirts and trousers. (4) Transitioning back to food details, a close-up shows black chopsticks lifting a piece of a thick omelet and placing it over a bowl of fried rice. The omelet is covered in a savory brown minced meat sauce with visible bits of green onion and red chili. (5) A close-up of the stir-fried green beans shows them being lifted by chopsticks to highlight their glossy, vibrant green texture. The beans are thin-sliced and mixed with bits of garlic, served on a white plate with blue accents. (6) A plate of golden-brown fried squid balls (Dragon Pearls) is shown, topped with crispy garlic bits, peanuts, and red chili. A spoon lifts one ball, revealing a crispy, thin batter and the soft white interior, set against the wooden table. (7) A close-up of salmon fried rice shows a metal spoon scooping up a portion of fluffy, yellowish rice mixed with flakes of pink salmon and scrambled eggs. Steam rises from the hot dish, emphasizing freshness in the restaurant's warm lighting. (8) A metal ladle scoops chicken wings and dark brown mushrooms from a clear, simmering broth in a stainless steel pot. The broth appears rich yet clear, and the motion highlights the tender texture of the ingredients within the soup. (9) The video concludes with a shot of the restaurant's printed paper menu, followed by a quick pan to a customer's pet dog sitting on a chair. Finally, an exterior shot at night shows the white 'Midnight' restaurant sign under warm yellow lamps.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Subtitle]: 高雄有一間. (2) [Subtitle]: 梅子雞很好吃的熱炒店. (3) [Subtitle]: 現在搬到鹽埕這裡了. (4) [Subtitle]: 以後到駁二附近也能順路來吃一下. (5) [Subtitle]: 梅汁雞是我們很喜歡的一道. (6) [Subtitle]: 外層酥香 裡面還有嫩度. (7) [Subtitle]: 酸酸的味道 配白飯真的很順口. (8) [Subtitle]: 煎蛋加入特製醬汁烹調. (9) [Subtitle]: 吃起來甘醇 帶有花椒香氣. (10) [Subtitle]: 香辣帶麻 很適合配飯. (11) [Subtitle]: 這個是用荷蘭豆切絲現炒. (12) [Subtitle]: 吃起來清脆爽口 還有淡淡的蒜香味. (13) [Subtitle]: 椒鹽龍珠 裹著薄薄的麵衣. (14) [Subtitle]: 炸到外酥內軟 搭配蒜酥和花生 口感有層次. (15) [Subtitle]: 主食可以試試鮭魚炒飯. (16) [Subtitle]: 老闆炒得蓬鬆不油膩 有些許鮭魚的鮮香味. (17) [Subtitle]: 你們冬天來的話 也有菇菇湯. (18) [Subtitle]: 是巴西蘑菇和鮮嫩帶骨雞肉一起煮. (19) [Subtitle]: 湯頭清香 喝起來蠻舒服的. (20) [Subtitle]: 想吃熱炒時可以考慮這間. (21) [Logo]: Midnight. [Slogan]: 武夜鹿鳴 高雄市鹽埕區五福四路152號 我們是虎麗笑嗨嗨 下次再一起吃美食囉.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as a promotional food vlog to inform local audiences about the relocation of a popular stir-fry restaurant in Kaohsiung. By showcasing signature dishes like Meizi Chicken and Omelet with high-quality visual close-ups and descriptive narration, it aims to entice viewers to visit the new location near the Pier-2 Art Center.
